weekly.input: Evidence-validated Daily Runtime publications for 2026-08-31 through 2026-09-06; pinned authoritative control commit c114aa98d19bbc305547e854eaee28cb6ae8b293 containing Scheduler V3.0, Worker Control v1.3.0 and generated Weekly Prompt v2.1.0; verified Weekly wake receipt research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-06/weekly-202821.json; the fresh 2026-09-06 Weekly Execution Slot Opened and Worker Claimed events; the P2 Registry and P2 Special Study Contract; current editorial/evidence policies; and current primary GitHub evidence for all six due P2 objects.
weekly.input_zh: 2026-08-31 至 2026-09-06 已通过证据验证的 Daily Runtime Publication、固定权威控制提交 c114aa98d19bbc305547e854eaee28cb6ae8b293 上的 Scheduler V3.0 / Worker Control v1.3.0 / Generated Weekly Prompt v2.1.0、已核验的 Weekly Wake Receipt research/runtime/wakes/2026/09/2026-09-06/weekly-202821.json、2026-09-06 fresh Weekly Execution Slot Opened 与 Worker Claimed 事件、P2 Registry 与 P2 Special Study Contract、当前编辑/证据政策，以及全部 6 个到期 P2 对象的当前 GitHub 一手证据。
weekly.workResult: Global serial admission verified that all earlier applicable 2026-09-06 formal tasks were execution-closed before Weekly received authority. Weekly then synthesized seven closed Daily Runtime days containing 15 published Research Center notes and one governed zero-output day into Weekly 008. The recurring cross-mechanism finding is that installed, approved, trusted, verified, checkpointed or stable identity are descriptive or evidentiary attributes, not execution authority by themselves. The synthesis models authority as a relation among principal, action, target, occurrence, protocol, policy epoch and current evidence, and introduces an Authority Relation Envelope as an engineering abstraction. P2 resolved all six due objects. PyOD v3.6.5 was the only trigger above threshold at 9/10; its full internal study independently reproduced the v3.6.4 synthetic-generator pathology in which 46 of 501 seeds produce a zero-variance labelled outlier block, and closed as an Experiment Candidate. The P2 study remains Pending Review and was not used as public evidence for the Weekly authority thesis.
weekly.workResult_zh: 全局串行准入已确认 2026-09-06 当日所有更早适用正式任务均已执行收口，Weekly 才获得执行权。随后将连续 7 个已收口 Daily Runtime 日中的 15 篇已发布 Research Center 研究和 1 个受控零输出日综合为 Weekly 008。本周跨机制重复出现的判断是：installed、approved、trusted、verified、checkpointed 或 stable identity 都只是描述事实或证据事实，本身不是执行权限。综合进一步把 Authority 建模为 Principal、Action、Target、Occurrence、Protocol、Policy Epoch 与当前 Evidence 的关系，并提出 Authority Relation Envelope 作为工程抽象。P2 的 6 个到期对象全部收口；PyOD v3.6.5 是唯一超过阈值的对象，评分 9/10。完整内部专项独立复现了 v3.6.4 合成数据生成器在 501 个 Seed 中有 46 个产生零方差标记 Outlier Block 的机制，并以 Experiment Candidate 收口。该 P2 专项仍为 Pending Review，未被作为 Weekly Authority 论点的公开证据。
weekly.output: Weekly 008 — Authority Is a Relation, Not an Attribute, published as independent Chinese and English Weekly Research pages with an editorial relation-gate cover; plus a contract-valid 2026-09-06 P2 run covering all six due objects and one Pending Review PyOD internal Special Study.
weekly.output_zh: 发布 Weekly 008《权限不是对象属性，而是一次关系》的中英文独立 Weekly Research 页面与关系门禁题图；同时形成符合合同的 2026-09-06 P2 运行记录，覆盖全部 6 个到期对象，并生成 1 份处于 Pending Review 的 PyOD 内部专项报告。
weekly.next: Next week, test the Authority Relation model directly: bounded authority-cache invalidation across target/account/policy changes; non-expansive multi-agent delegation composition; recovery transitions at pre-call, unknown-effect and pending-approval interruption points; and protocol selection where risk changes review intensity but does not independently choose the authorization protocol. Continue P2 checks from the verified 2026-09-06 checkpoints, and do not promote the PyOD study publicly unless its separate review permits normal article-candidate handoff.
weekly.next_zh: 下一周直接验证 Authority Relation Model：测试 Target / Account / Policy 变化时的有边界 Authority Cache 失效、Multi-agent Delegation 的非扩张组合、Tool Call 前 / External Effect 未知 / Pending Approval 三种中断点的 Recovery Transition，以及 Risk 只改变审核强度而不单独决定 Authorization Protocol 的协议选择。P2 从 2026-09-06 已核验检查点继续增量检查；除非 PyOD 专项经过独立审核并允许进入正常 Article Candidate 流程，否则不得公开晋级。
